tips.text: Land Devastating Fire from long range; the fireball is fast and explodes on the first enemy it hits, so it works well against champions standing behind minions.
Use Severing Bolt on enemies who are alone or stuck in place; it hurts far more the lower their health is.
Follow Gaze of the Abyss or Crushing Maw with Severing Bolt; a rooted or dragged enemy can't dodge the delayed lightning.
Hit an enemy with two different damaging spells to leave a signature under them, then expect it to blow up after a short delay.
Use Grim Visage on anyone who dives you; it knocks them down and slows them, so you can walk away.
Cast Stirring Lights before a trade; your next few attacks or spells deal extra damage and give mana back.
Hold Spiraling Despair for a fight where the enemy can't escape; it slows them while it grows, then shatters for big damage.
Hwei is open to being rushed down after he casts a Torment spell, so use them from a safe spot.

combos.name: Wash Brush mood cancel
combos.when: You opened a mood and want to change plans without paying any cooldown or mana.
combos.text: Press R while in a mood to exit it for free. Use it when the enemy dodges your plan or a different spell is needed.

tips.text: Cast Devastating Fire at long range down the lane; it flies fast and stops at the first enemy it hits, so aim past your own minions' path.
Hit an enemy with a second different ability to set off your signature. The blast has a delay, so cast it when they can't easily step away.
Use Severing Bolt on an enemy who is rooted or stuck alone. It hits much harder on a target who can't move, but it lands late.
Open with Gaze of the Abyss to root the first enemy it hits. Follow with Severing Bolt or Devastating Fire for a heavy hit.
Use Crushing Maw on enemies bunched up or fighting your support. It drags them to the center and slows them.
Cast Stirring Lights before a trade; your next few attacks or spells deal extra damage and give back mana.
Use Pool of Reflection to shield you and your support while they stand in it, or Fleeting Current to speed up a chase or escape.
Stay behind your minions after casting a Torment spell. Hwei is open to being rushed down while he recovers.
Use Wash Brush to leave a mood you picked by mistake. It costs no mana and starts no cooldown.
Save Spiraling Despair for a target you can finish or catch. It slows them more the longer it stays stuck, then bursts.
Aim Grim Visage or Gaze of the Abyss at Ahri when she walks up, because Charm is her only way to start a trade. Fear or root stops her from winning it.
Don't stand in a line with minions in front of you; Ahri's Charm stops at the first enemy it hits, so put a minion between you and her.
Use Severing Bolt when Ahri is rooted or alone; it hits much harder then, but it is slow, so aim where she will be.
Be careful with your Torment spells at close range. After one, Ahri can rush you with Spirit Rush, so keep space.
Poke Ahri with Molten Fissure to keep her slowed and away from the minions. She lives off the healing she gets from last-hitting.
Aim Severing Bolt at Akali when she is rooted, or when she dashes in alone; it deals extra damage the lower her health is.
Hit Akali with Grim Visage when she dives in. It knocks her down and she cannot reach you.
Throw spells at her smoke from Twilight Shroud; area spells hit her inside it and reveal her briefly.
Back off when your health is low and Akali has Perfect Execution ready.
Stay out of Anivia's line when Flash Frost comes; if it hits and ends in a stun, you are stunned and take Frostbite at double damage.
Use Severing Bolt on Anivia when she is rooted or alone; it hits harder on those targets, and it is slow, so aim ahead.
Punish Anivia when she is out of position with a long-range Molten Fissure; its lava slows her.
Aurora can go invisible with Across the Veil and escape. Save a slow or root for when she hops in, and don't spend it early.
Use Crushing Maw or Gaze of the Abyss when Aurora commits to a fight. Her dashes stop working while she is rooted.
Step out of the way of Twofold Hex, then dodge the bolt coming back. Her recast hurts more when you are low on health.
Stay out of Between Worlds' ring. Enemies who touch its edge are slowed, and she can hop across it freely.
Do not paint a Torment spell when Cassiopeia is close; after it you are easy to rush down.
Keep Cassiopeia from poisoning you; her Twin Fang hurts a lot more on a poisoned target. Dodge Noxious Blast by stepping out of the area.
Turn away when Cassiopeia casts Petrifying Gaze so you are slowed instead of stunned.
Use Gaze of the Abyss to root her when she walks in to poke; it gives you time to follow up.
Keep Hwei's Subject: Torment for when Fizz dashes in, and aim at the spot he will land in. Being rooted or pulled ruins his follow-up.
Hold your Severing Bolt until Fizz is rooted or can't move, because it does far more damage then. It is slow, so he can easily step out of it otherwise.
Stay away from Fizz when his trident is glowing; his hits hurt much more for a few seconds.
Bait out Playful before you commit your spells; Fizz is hard to hit while it is available.
Cast Severing Bolt at Malzahar when he is alone or stuck in place; it hits much harder on those targets.
Malzahar's Void Shift blocks most damage and crowd control until he's hit. Break it with a cheap poke before you commit your stun or root.
Keep your distance from Call of the Void; being silenced mid-combo wastes your spells. Step out of the gap between the portals.
Avoid fighting beside minions marked by Malefic Visions; when they die, it spreads to you.
Hit Malzahar with Gaze of the Abyss to root him when he walks up to fight, then follow up with damage.
Aim Severing Bolt at Orianna when she is stunned or alone; it hurts most then. She can sidestep it, so use it when she is busy.
Keep your distance from Orianna after painting a Torment spell, because she can rush you while it recharges.
Orianna's Ball only affects the area around it. Check where it sits and stay out of range of her spells.
Use Crushing Maw on Orianna to pull her toward the center, so she is slowed and can't easily kite back.
Keep your distance from Ryze. He deals much more damage to targets marked with Flux.
Hit Ryze with Severing Bolt when he is rooted or alone; it deals far more damage to low-health targets.
Use Grim Visage on Ryze when he walks up to cast on you. It fears him and knocks him down, so he can't finish his combo.
Ryze needs to be in range to cast. Poke him with Devastating Fire when he walks up to last-hit.
Hit Sylas with Crushing Maw when he dashes in; it pulls him to the center and slows him.
Use Severing Bolt on Sylas when he is rooted or alone; it deals far more damage.
Watch his health bar; Kingslayer heals him when he is low, so do not rely on a near-kill.
Poke him from far away with Devastating Fire and keep your distance, since he wins close fights.
Catch Twisted Fate with Gaze of the Abyss or Grim Visage, then follow up with damage. Rooted or feared, he cannot dodge.
Hit Twisted Fate with Severing Bolt when he is stuck in place or alone; it hurts much more that way.
Watch for Twisted Fate shuffling his cards above his head. Back away when the Gold Card is picked so the stun misses you.
When Destiny goes off, expect a gank or a teleport. Move toward your tower or stay near allies.
Wild Cards fans out in a cone, so use Fleeting Current to run away, or step out of the cone to avoid it.
Walk out of Viktor's Gravity Field early; staying inside gets you stunned.
Keep distance from Viktor; his control grows the closer you stand. Use Severing Bolt to hit him from far away.
Use Gaze of the Abyss or Crushing Maw to hold Viktor still, then follow with damage while he is rooted or slowed.
Hit Viktor with two different damaging spells to leave a Signature under him, then keep him from walking out.
Hit Yasuo with Gaze of the Abyss when he dashes in; the root stops his movement and sets up your damage.
Don't waste fireballs or the eye into Wind Wall; wait for it to fade, then cast.
Land Severing Bolt on Yasuo while he is rooted for big damage.
Stay away from minions when Yasuo has two Steel Tempest stacks; his whirlwind knocks you up and he can follow with Last Breath.
Keep Yone at range with Molten Fissure and Devastating Fire. He wants to get close and trade.
Save Grim Visage or Crushing Maw for when Yone dashes in with Mortal Steel. They stop him from landing his knock up.
Stay out of the long line of Fate Sealed at level 6. It stuns you and pulls you to him.
Gaze of the Abyss roots Yone, so use it when he commits. Then Severing Bolt hits him much harder.
Keep Crushing Maw or Gaze of the Abyss ready for when Zed dashes in; being rooted or pulled lets you survive his burst.
Hit Zed with Devastating Fire when he walks up; it travels fast and does more damage to higher-health targets.
Hit Zed's shadow's slash zone carefully; if Zed has just used Living Shadow, he is weak and easy to punish.
Pool of Reflection gives you a shield before Death Mark goes off; use it to absorb damage.
Stay away from Zed's shadows when you can; the slow from Shadow Slash only applies if a shadow hits you.
Use Gaze of the Abyss or Crushing Maw on Ashe, then follow with Devastating Fire. She has few ways to escape.
Use Severing Bolt when Ashe is rooted or stuck in place, or when she is alone. It hits harder the lower her health is.
Stay out of Volley range after you commit a Torment spell. Ashe will rush you down while that spell is on cooldown.
Hit Ashe with two different damaging spells to trigger your signature explosion. She can walk out of it, so cast it when she is slowed or pinned.
Watch for Ashe's Enchanted Crystal Arrow when you move up the lane alone. If it is ready, stay near your team.
Hit Caitlyn with Subject: Disaster from far away. Severing Bolt reaches a long way, but it is slow, so aim where she is walking.
Watch the ground for Yordle Snap Trap and don't walk over it. When you are rooted, Caitlyn gets a strong Headshot on you.
Stay behind your minions, because Piltover Peacemaker deals less damage to each target after the first.
Root Caitlyn with Subject: Torment (Gaze of the Abyss) or pull her in with Crushing Maw, then hit her with Severing Bolt for big damage.
Caitlyn's net pushes her away from you, so don't chase her after she uses it. Wait until it is on cooldown to go in.
Aim Devastating Fire at Ezreal when he lines up Mystic Shot; he is fragile and the fireball is fast.
Land Gaze of the Abyss when Ezreal is near, so he is rooted and cannot dodge your follow-up.
Hit Ezreal with Severing Bolt while he is rooted or alone; it does much more damage then.
Stay behind minions; Ezreal's Mystic Shot stops at the first enemy it hits.
Stay out of Jhin's basic attack range and do not stand still while he reloads and has traps ready; he punishes a Hwei who stays in range.
Watch for invisible traps from Jhin before you walk into the lane; stepping on one slows you and then it explodes.
Do not take damage from Jhin or his support and then stand still; Deadly Flourish roots you from very far away.
Jump on Jhin after his fourth shot while he is reloading, and use Crushing Maw to pull him in and slow him.
Use Devastating Fire to poke Jhin from range; the fireball is fast and stops on the first enemy it hits.
Use Gaze of the Abyss or Crushing Maw from Subject: Torment on Jinx when she stands still; being rooted or slowed leaves her open to your follow-up.
Send Severing Bolt from Subject: Disaster at Jinx when she is rooted or alone; it deals far more damage to such targets.
Wait out Flame Chompers! before you dive Jinx; if she wastes it, she will struggle to escape.
Stay out of the long range of Zap! and out of Jinx's rocket range; you can't afford to take slowed pokes.
Hit Kai'Sa with Gaze of the Abyss or Crushing Maw when she dashes in, to keep her from reaching you.
Hit Kai'Sa with Severing Bolt when she is alone or rooted; it does far more damage to a lone target.
Outrange her with Devastating Fire and Severing Bolt from far away; Kai'Sa is weak when mages out-range her.
Watch for Killer Instinct. When she jumps on you, use Grim Visage to stop her up close.
Use Fleeting Current to give you and your support extra speed to dodge Icathian Rain's missiles and to escape.
Use Gaze of the Abyss to root Miss Fortune when she walks up. Then follow with Severing Bolt for big damage on an immobilized target.
Hit Miss Fortune with any damage to end her Strut speed boost. Molten Fissure's lava is an easy way to do it.
Don't stand in Make It Rain; it slows you and adds up damage. Step out of the area fast.
Save Spiraling Despair for Miss Fortune herself when she is out of position. She is easy to kill once you reach her.
Use Gaze of the Abyss or Grim Visage to catch Sivir, but bait out Spell Shield first with a cheaper spell.
Sivir is slowed and pinned down by Crushing Maw; follow up while she is stuck.
Dodge Boomerang Blade. If it hits you on the way out, stay out of its path on the way back.
Do not leave Sivir alone with the wave. Ricochet pushes fast, so clear it and keep your turret safe.
Use Severing Bolt on Sivir when she is alone or stuck, because it hits harder then.
Hit Smolder with a Subject: Disaster spell early. He is weak before he has stacked up, so zone him from last-hitting.
Use Crushing Maw to pull Smolder in, or Gaze of the Abyss to root him, then follow up with Severing Bolt.
Hit Smolder with two different spells in a row. The second one triggers your signature explosion on him.
Hit Smolder with the Grim Visage fear when he flies in, as it stops him from escaping or trading.
Hit Yunara with Crushing Maw to pull her in and slow her. It has a delay, so aim where she is walking.
Use Gaze of the Abyss to root Yunara when she steps forward, then follow with Severing Bolt for big damage.
Poke Yunara with Devastating Fire from range while she has few Unleash stacks. Minions in the line will stop it.
Respect Yunara once she turns on her ultimate, since she hits fast and can dash. Keep your Grim Visage ready to stop her.
Stay out of the long line of Yunara's prayer bead; being slowed leaves you open to her attacks.
